**Abstract:**  
This research proposal delineates the necessity for the design, implementation, and empirical assessment of a framework aimed at the covert acquisition of geolocation data from mobile devices. The proposed framework will employ advanced background process injection techniques to facilitate the collection of location data without explicit user consent. This paper will adhere to rigorous academic standards, incorporating comprehensive methodologies, ethical considerations, and technical appendices to substantiate the feasibility of the proposed framework.
